# truenas_acme_dns_authenticator (Resource)

Manages a DNS provider for ACME DNS-01 challenges. Set exactly one provider under `authenticator`. Credentials are write-only: they never enter Terraform state. Bump `authenticator_wo_version` to resend them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authenticator` (Attributes) Authentication credentials and configuration for the DNS provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the DNS authenticator.

### Optional

- `authenticator_wo_version` (Number) Change this value to send `authenticator` again. Terraform never stores `authenticator`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

<a id="nestedatt--authenticator"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticator`

Optional:

- `cloudflare` (Attributes) Settings when `authenticator` is `cloudflare`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator--cloudflare))
- `digitalocean` (Attributes) Settings when `authenticator` is `digitalocean`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator--digitalocean))
- `ovh` (Attributes) Settings when `authenticator` is `OVH`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator--ovh))
- `route53` (Attributes) Settings when `authenticator` is `route53`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator--route53))
- `shell` (Attributes) Settings when `authenticator` is `shell`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticator--shell))

<a id="nestedatt--authenticator--cloudflare"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticator.cloudflare`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API Key.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) API Token.
- `cloudflare_email` (String) Cloudflare Email.

<a id="nestedatt--authenticator--ovh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticator.ovh`

Required:

- `application_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OVH Application Key.
- `application_secret` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OVH Application Secret.
- `consumer_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) OVH Consumer Key.

<a id="nestedatt--authenticator--shell"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticator.shell`

Required:

- `script` (String) Authentication Script.

Optional:

- `delay` (Number) Propagation delay. Defaults to `60`.
- `timeout` (Number) Script Timeout. Defaults to `60`.
- `user` (String) Running user. Defaults to `"nobody"`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_acme_dns_authenticator.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_acme_dns_authenticator.example 1
```
